g.text: Uno logical pin map: MODEM TX to Uno D0; MODEM RX to Uno D1. J1 pin map: modem TX goes to Uno D0/RX; modem RX is driven from Uno D1/TX through the board-approved level interface.

g.text: Use the exact modem board?s regulated voltage and burst-current supply. A bare SIM800L is not a 5 V UART device. Physical cellular service was not tested.
